title: Quadratic inner proof
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits, and let $p$ be a Boolean string of length equal to the circuit’s quadratic PCPP proof length. The quadratic inner proof is the Boolean string on the inner-proof positions whose value at each position is the value of $p$ at the corresponding inner-proof index.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit $C$ on $n$ input bits
A Boolean proof string of length equal to the quadratic PCPP proof length
caveat: The definition of the inner-proof index is not included, so its coordinate assignment cannot be stated more explicitly.
